title: A task Proof or Files line that names a missing path is refused at create
body:
Outcome: a task whose Proof or Files line names a repository path that does not exist is refused when it is created or edited, so the pre-push Proof run never finds a missing file after a full local check.
Proof: `node --test test/task/quality.test.ts` passes with a case where a Proof naming a missing test file is refused at create.
Evidence: t-8v6620r named scripts/lib/fast-plan.ts and test/scripts/fast-plan.test.ts, which never existed; pre-push refused the push with exit 81 only after fast had passed, and the record had to be reopened to fix its body.
Files: src/task/ (create/edit validation), test/task/
